description: Na₂ScIn(SiO₃)₄ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.95 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.94 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.24 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one InO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one In, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, one In, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, one In, and one Si atom.
